repo.description:
### Background

NATS is an open source messaging system for cloud, on-premises and edge deployments.

NATS Server supports MQTT clients over TCP and WebSocket and uses payload limits to constrain incoming data.

### Problem Description

After MQTT connection establishment, packet buffering did not consistently enforce the configured payload-derived size limit. A client could cause excessive buffering and copying before later processing checks were applied. This could exhaust memory or CPU and affect all accounts and protocols served by the process. Authentication is required only where the MQTT listener is configured to require it.

### Affected Versions

The issue is fixed in v2.14.8 and v2.15.1. Earlier versions containing the affected functionality are vulnerable; the first affected version has not been established for this notice.

### Workarounds

Upgrade to a fixed release.

### References

 * GHSA advisory: <https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/security/advisories/GHSA-72gq-694q-fj66>
 * Credit: ARSB (@ARSB1)
repo.summary: Connected MQTT clients can bypass packet buffering limits
